paragraphs: Mentioned in the Mekhilta, Beshalach, “Food”: he brings evidence for the words of ר״א of Modi'in. The Yalkut there reads simply R' Yose.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: מביא is an inherited contextual editorial repair of damaged כביא/כיבא, not new pixel certainty; the earlier competing forms and source repair record remain preserved. Beshalach mazon is kept as the source label, with Food a lexical gloss, no invented external locus.

ר״א is unresolved here; the current Elazar expansion is not supported by a bound exact named passage, and familiar epithet alone does not settle the initials or title. The supplied Yose titles remain R'.

The Yalkut omission of the regional epithet is Hyman’s claim, with there indicating an unspecified parallel location. The inherited provisional heading and repair remain unadjudicated; no identity or place binding follows.
